title: Bihar BTSC Staff Nurse DV Objection 2026
vacancyDetails: DV objection window for BTSC Staff Nurse recruitment 2026
qualification: As per BTSC Staff Nurse notification
selectionProcess: Written / merit stages → Document Verification → Objection window → Final merit
documentsRequired: Registration credentials; documents related to DV objection grounds
howToApply:
1. Visit official BTSC portal
2. Open Staff Nurse DV Objection notice
3. Login and submit objection with supporting documents
4. Keep acknowledgment for reference
shortDescription: Bihar BTSC Staff Nurse DV Objection 2026 open. Submit objections on the official BTSC portal as per schedule.
content:
Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) has opened the Staff Nurse Document Verification (DV) Objection process for 2026.

Eligible candidates can raise objections against DV findings within the notified dates only through the official website.
